name: print_timeline
description: Print the timeline as its literal TSX projection (header with media table, pending count and rev, then <track> and item elements, one per line). Always print before editing; use from/lines to read part of a long timeline.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: apply_timeline
description: Apply an edit to the timeline as one undoable revision. Give `edits` (each oldText must occur exactly once in the printed timeline of `rev`; newText replaces it; empty newText deletes) with the `rev` from the header you edited, or a whole replacement `source`. Edits the person made meanwhile are merged. Returns what changed, conflicts and warnings, or the diagnostics that refused the edit.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: The rev from the printed header the edits were made against

edits.description: Text edits against the printed timeline

source.description: Complete replacement projection text (instead of edits)

prefer.description: Which side wins a conflict with edits the person made meanwhile (default file)

name: verify_timeline
description: Report problems: overlapping items, gaps on the main track, clips running past their source, missing or offline media, pending placeholders.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: undo_timeline
description: Undo your most recent change that is not undone yet (or your revision `rev`) as a new revision. Only your own changes are undone; edits the person or other agents made meanwhile stay. Refused with undo.conflict, listing the items, when a later change touched the same fields.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: One of your revisions to undo (default: your latest)

name: list_media
description: The project's media: id, name (usable as src), kind, duration, online/offline status and use count.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: add_media
description: Add files to a project by absolute path: each is probed, registered and placed as a clip (video/images on Main, audio on Audio, after the last clip unless `at` is given).

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

at.description: Start of the first clip in seconds

name: grab_frame
description: Decode one frame of a media item or file; returns it as an image.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

grid.description: Overlay a labelled grid in the frame's pixels from its centre, with safe-area boxes

name: filmstrip
description: Contact sheet of frames across a media file (or a range); returns the image and the frame times.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

storyboard.description: A storyboard instead: frames across the whole file, repeats dropped, at most 36 tiles with timecodes

name: detect_scenes
description: Hard cuts in a video: times (s) and scores.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

name: audio_levels
description: Peak and RMS level (dBFS) per bucket across an audio or video file.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

name: detect_silence
description: Ranges quieter than a threshold for at least a minimum length — candidates for cuts. `mode: "speech"` finds dead air instead: pauses that voice activity finds and that are `relativeDb` below the speaker's own level (music beds stay), per media in source seconds; the document is not changed.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

padding.description: Seconds kept each side, default 0.15, 0–0.5 (speech mode)

relativeDb.description: dB below the speech level, default 12 (speech mode)

name: look
description: Render composited timeline frames (what the export will show) and return them as images, optionally with brightness stats.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

grid.description: Overlay a labelled grid in transform units (pixels from the canvas centre) with title-safe and action-safe boxes

storyboard.description: One storyboard sheet of the whole timeline instead: repeats dropped, at most 36 tiles, each with its timecode and the ids of the visible items

name: seek
description: Move the app's playhead to a time in seconds so the person sees that moment.

name: check_code
description: Check a code item's composition before (or after) applying it: transpiles the TSX, reports syntax errors, imports and unavailable globals with line:column, then renders frames at the start, middle and end and reports runtime errors, endless loops, unsupported elements and styles, console output and the slowest frame time. Pass the codeComposition object ({source, props?, assets?} or {template, props}).

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: ask_user
description: Ask the person a question when a choice is genuinely theirs (style, which take, what to cut). Offer 2-4 short options when you can. Blocks until they answer.

name: undo_my_changes
description: Undo every change of this session (scope session, the default) or of one turn (scope turn) as one new revision, keeping everyone else's edits. Refused with undo.conflict, listing the items, when a later change by someone else touched the same fields.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

turn.description: The turn id (default: the current turn)

name: edit_timeline
description: Run one edit verb as one revision (one undo step): split, trim, rippleTrim, rippleDelete, delete, insert, overwrite, lift, extract, closeGap, slip, slide, roll, move. Later items ripple on sync-locked tracks, linked items edit together, times snap to the frame grid. `request` is the edit as JSON, e.g. {"op":"rippleDelete","tracks":["a1"],"ranges":[{"start":12.3,"end":14}]} (seconds). Returns the plan and the printed lines of what changed; a refusal names a code and the culprit item ids. With `rev`, a request made against an older revision is moved through the ripples made since.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: Revision the request was made against (default: the current one)

preview.description: Return the plan without applying it

markers.description: Markers follow a ripple: later markers shift with it, points inside a removed range go

name: list_models_local
description: List the local machine-learning models (id, purpose, licence, size in bytes, whether installed, folder). Models over 50 MB install only with the person's consent: in the app's Settings > Storage, or `ove models install <id> --yes` typed by the person.

name: get_transcript
description: The words said on the timeline, in timeline order: id (`<mediaId>@<sourceMs>`, stable across edits), text, timeline start and end in seconds, clip id, source times and a filler flag, with the project `rev` they were read at. Pages at 10,000 words (`offset`, `limit`). `segments: true` gives sentences instead. Media without a transcript are listed in `untranscribed`.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

clips.description: Only these clip ids (default: every clip with sound)

model.description: Only transcripts made with this speech model (tiny, base, small)

language.description: Only transcripts in this language (ISO 639-1), with `model`

name: remove_words
description: Cut words from the timeline as one revision: word ids from `get_transcript`, `ranges` of ids (`from` to `to` in timeline order) or exact phrases (`match`). Each cut keeps part of the natural pause (`pause`: tight 60 ms, balanced 150 ms, loose 320 ms), snaps its edges to the quietest point near the word, fades the seam, and later items close the gap; captions drop the cut words. Ids read at an older `rev` stay valid. `apply: false` returns the plan and the `timeline.tsx` diff without changing anything.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

match.description: Exact phrases; every occurrence is cut

pause.description: Pause kept at each seam (default balanced)

rev.description: Revision the ids were read at

name: remove_silence
description: Cut dead air from the timeline as one revision: pauses found with on-device voice activity that are at least `relativeDb` (default 12) below the speaker's own level and at least `minPause` long (default 0.5 s), keeping `padding` (default 0.15 s) on each side except at clip edges. Music beds and loud ambience stay. Needs the inference runtime (the person installs it in Settings > Storage). `apply: false` returns the plan and the `timeline.tsx` diff.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

clips.description: Only these clip ids (default: every clip with sound)

name: find_fillers
description: Filler candidates on the timeline for review: listed filler words (`um`, `uh`, …) selected by default, context-dependent words (`like`, `you know`) flagged but not selected, and voiced sounds no word covers (after dead-air detection). Word candidates carry ids for `remove_words`. Nothing is cut.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: search_transcript
description: Find a phrase in everything said in the project's transcribed media, ignoring case, accents and punctuation. Each hit gives the media, word-accurate source start and end in seconds, the word ids, and every place on the timeline that plays it. `untranscribed` counts media with no transcript yet.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: transcribe_media
description: Recognise a media file's speech on this computer (no upload) and cache the words in the project, so `get_transcript`, `search_transcript` and the cutting tools can use them. A cached transcript is returned unless `force`. Speech models over 50 MB install only with the person's consent (Settings > Storage, or `ove models install whisper-base --yes`); without it the call returns `model.consent` with the size.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

name: duck_audio
description: Lower music under dialogue as one revision: writes volume keyframes on the music items (ramp down `attack` before each line of speech, `depth` dB during it, back up over `release`; lines closer than `hold` merge). Speech comes from the dialogue's cached transcript, else from its level. `mode` replace (default) rewrites volume keyframes only in the affected range, so running again replaces an earlier duck; merge multiplies with existing ones. `dryRun` returns the planned keyframes per music item without changing anything.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

music.description: Music item ids or track ids/names (list, or comma-separated)

under.description: Dialogue item ids or track ids/names (list, or comma-separated)

attack.description: Seconds of ramp down before speech (default 0.2)

release.description: Seconds of ramp up after speech (default 0.4)

hold.description: Lines closer than this many seconds merge (default 0.5)

source.description: transcript, level or auto (default: transcript when cached, else level)

dryRun.description: Return the plan without applying it

name: list_models
description: List the AI generation models (id, kind, provider, durations, aspect ratios, list price, whether the person has added the provider's key), with this session's confirmed spend and its cap. Prices are estimates; the provider bills the person.

name: generate_image
description: Generate a still image and place it as a clip. Spends the person's money in two steps: call without `confirm` to get the plan, the estimate and a quoteId (nothing is spent); then call again with the same arguments and `confirm: <quoteId>`, and a person approves the price in the app or their client. The quote lasts 10 minutes and is valid only for that exact request; a session cannot spend above the person's cap (spend.cap). Approved, a pending placeholder goes on the timeline (one revision you can undo) and the receipt gives its item id, its printed line and the jobId for generation_status.

model.description: Model id from list_models (default: the kind's default model)

start.description: Timeline start in seconds (default: after the track's last clip)

track.description: Track name or id (default: Overlay for pictures, Audio for sound)

confirm.description: The quoteId from the first call. Spending still needs a person to approve the price; this argument alone never spends.

name: send_feedback
description: Draft a report about OpenVideoEditor itself (a bug, something confusing or missing, an idea) for the person to review. It is stored on this computer only and never sent: the person reads it in Help > Feedback, edits or deletes it, and sends it themselves if they want. Write the summary in your own words: what you tried, what happened, what you expected. Leave out names, file paths, prompts and anything else the person typed or showed. The app and OS versions and this session's last tool names are added. At most 8 reports per session; an exact duplicate is not stored again.

name: list_tasks
description: List the app's unfinished background tasks (thumbnails, skim sheets, proxies, captions, export, analysis): id, kind, label, project, priority, state (queued, running, paused with its reason) and progress. Background work runs only in the app: without it the list is empty.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

kind.description: Only this kind (thumbnail, skim, proxy, captions, export, audio-analysis, …)

name: wait_tasks
description: Wait until the matching background tasks are done (for example the proxies of a project), or until the time-out: the result says whether they are done and how many remain. Paused tasks (playback, battery) do not finish while paused.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

kind.description: Only this kind (thumbnail, skim, proxy, captions, export, audio-analysis, …)

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait at most (default 30, at most 600)

name: cancel_task
description: Cancel one background task by id (from list_tasks). It stops within a second and leaves no partial output; the result reports it cancelled. Derived data (thumbnails, skim sheets, proxies) is queued again the next time it is needed.

name: list_markers
description: List the timeline markers in time order: id, time and duration in seconds, name, colour, note, status (open, review, resolved), assignee, and the ids of the items under each marker. Filter with `status` and `assignee` (for example open markers assigned to `agent`).

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

status.description: Only markers with this status: open, review or resolved

assignee.description: Only markers assigned to this name (`agent`, `user`, …)

name: add_marker
description: Add a marker at `at` seconds (a range with `dur`), as one revision. Status defaults to open. Markers carry review work: an agent never sets `resolved` (refused); see update_marker.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

dur.description: Duration in seconds (default 0: a point marker)

color.description: red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink or #rrggbb

assignee.description: Who should act on it: `agent`, `user` or a name

name: update_marker
description: Change one marker as one revision: time, duration, name, colour, note, status or assignee; `unset` removes name, color, note or assignee. Markers carry review work: list open markers assigned to `agent`, make the edit, check it with `look`, then set the marker's status to `review`. Never set `resolved`: only the person resolves a marker, and the request is refused with `marker.resolveByAgent`.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

status.description: open, review or resolved (resolved: people only)

unset.description: Fields to remove: name, color, note, assignee

name: remove_markers
description: Remove markers by id as one revision.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: edit_keyframes
description: Set, add or remove the keyframes of one property of one item, as one revision. Properties: x, y, scale, rotation, opacity, gaussianBlur, borderRadius, volume (sound items, 0-200), crop.top, crop.right, crop.bottom, crop.left (percent). Times are seconds from the item's start and must lie inside the item (`keyframe.outOfRange` otherwise). Each keyframe may set `easing` for the segment that starts at it (linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out, hold: keep the value until the next keyframe). `set` replaces the list (empty removes it), `add` adds or replaces keyframes at their times, `remove` takes times.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

property.description: The keyframed property, e.g. opacity or crop.left

add.description: Keyframes to add: [{time, value, easing?}] or "1:0.5:hold"

remove.description: Times of the keyframes to remove (seconds from the item's start)

easing.description: The track's easing for segments without their own

preview.description: Return the plan without applying it

name: save_version
description: Save the current revision as a named version ("client v2") with an optional note. Versions survive history pruning and can be printed, compared and restored later. A name already in use is refused with `version.exists`.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: list_versions
description: List the project's named versions, oldest first: name, revision, time, who saved it, note and the bytes it added.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)
